WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           SUM(sr.SR_FEE) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
      AND s.s_state = 'TN'
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM (
    SELECT ctr_customer_sk,
           ctr_store_sk,
           ctr_total_return,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_store_sk) * 1.2 AS avg_return
    FROM customer_total_return
) AS ctr1
JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr1.avg_return
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
